answer: New identities cannot wander in freely, since every fresh registration requires its own bond and history. Sybil resistance via a staked-identity atlas: each agent must lock a bond that only unlocks after a verifiable voyage of sustained, peer-attested work across multiple epochs. Attackers must front real capital per fake identity and risk slashing if peers detect duplicate behavior, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0085 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
